claims.sentence: In this study, we aimed to assess the effects of CPAP on white matter (WM) integrity using longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) tests.Methods Twenty-two male patients with moderate to severe OSA were recruited, and thepatients underwent DTI scanning before and 6-44 months after CPAP treatment.
